_comment: C0-16 正文英译 · andi（2026-10-25）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（kagi/perplexity/metaso），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [kagi, perplexity, metaso, chatgpt]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 照源短译（含三条实测建议段）。

axes.model_access: An in-house retrieval-plus-generation stack: the Trantora AI index covers 25B+ pages, ranks by meaning and credibility and filters spam at ingestion; generation uses an ensemble of models, and the API exposes low-cost, fast, balanced, deep and exhaustive `searchMode` tiers, auto-selected or pinned (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web at andisearch.com plus a PWA, Chrome extension, REST API (`https://api.andiai.com`), remote MCP (`https://api.andiai.com/mcp`) and CLI; retrieval and generation run in the vendor cloud, while the CLI runs locally (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Anonymous use needs no account: settings and history stay in browser storage. The API returns structured JSON or LLM-ready Markdown, with `format=context` feeding RAG directly and no local file writes; the CLI reads `ANDI_API_KEY` from the environment (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Request-response: fast mode returns sub-second, deep takes about 2–3 seconds and exhaustive maximises coverage. There is no hosted job queue or resume-after-shutdown surface; long workflows are split by the caller (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Direct answers with sources, an ad-free Reader Mode, Summarize and News/Images/Videos tabs; the API offers `/api/v1/search`, `/api/v1/fetch`, multi-query (up to five merged and deduplicated), an OpenSearch-compatible endpoint, `format=context` and MCP search/fetch tools (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Anonymous searches are not logged and no profile is built, so there is no cross-session memory; signed-in accounts store only what the feature needs; browser storage holds local settings and history, and each MCP/API call is independent (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: The consumer product is free, ad-free, untracked and anonymous by default; the API is outcome-priced (official page cites under 1¢ per query, with `metrics.cost_dollars` in each response) and authenticated with `x-api-key`; the privacy policy promises no data sales and no search logging (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: lightweight research needing direct answers with verifiable sources, privacy-sensitive users, free ad-free search and search APIs for agents/RAG. Not fit: deep academic vertical search, Chinese-first work or fully auditable search logs (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official site, About, FAQ, privacy policy and API docs. Answer quality, source coverage and the no-tracking claim need a shared question set and network-level observation.
unknowns:
- Technical details of the in-house stack: official pages describe the Trantora index and an ensemble; check the API docs for model lists.
- Long-term viability and funding: the official FAQ cites Y Combinator backing.
- Training-use controls: check the privacy policy and account settings.
- Chinese query quality: measure Chinese versus English on a shared question set.
related: Also privacy-oriented search: Kagi self-builds its index on a subscription model, Andi self-builds its answer architecture for free.
Route contrast: Perplexity aggregates retrieval + citations, Andi generates answers directly.
Chinese counterpart: Metaso goes deep in Chinese, Andi is English-leaning and lightweight.
